title: Road to Tijuana
description: The Supreme Donk Championships travel through select GLB cities as a stadium event series built around custom cars, live judging, and city champions. Winners are crowned on-site and advance toward the circuit final in Tijuana.

champions.name: NuMONEY
champions.theme: Candy red / cream drip • Pall Mall theme
champions.caption: NuMONEY’s Caprice cleared the Durham mark under the lights and became the defining image of the circuit’s opening stop.

champions.name: Toi Boi Roi
champions.theme: Banana yellow candy drip • Arcade jungle theme
champions.caption: Toi Boi Roi earned Best Style honors with a controlled tripod lean, chrome-heavy finish, and a nightlife build that owned the Taipei stop.

champions.name: Big Rell
champions.theme: Deep candy burgundy • Chrome-forward Southern build
champions.caption: Big Rell brought the most restrained and intimidating build of the circuit, winning Atlanta on presence, stance, and total authority.

champions.name: Perk-O-Lata
champions.theme: Aqua / teal candy drip • Ton O’ Suds Carwash theme
champions.caption: The Albuquerque field belonged to Perk-O-Lata, whose glossy wash-cycle build turned a full concept into one of the circuit’s strongest identities.

champions.name: Clementine Latham
champions.theme: French’s Mustard theme • Ballpark condiment build
champions.caption: Clementine Latham stood out in the Naturals’ ballpark setting with a bold, playful build that still felt fully serious in execution.

champions.name: Michael Bonnehomme
champions.theme: Swedish Fish theme • Red and aqua city-night finish
champions.caption: Bonnehomme’s Citation gave Vancouver one of the circuit’s sharpest color stories, landing Best Style with a clean and playful build.

champions.name: Daryl Deez
champions.theme: Green Giant Green Beans theme • Heavy green field build
champions.caption: Veteran builder Daryl Deez brought full commitment to Fresno with a Green Giant Caprice that dominated on theme, tone, and crowd response.

champions.name: Omar Azul
champions.theme: Good & Plenty theme • Purple and white coastal finish
champions.caption: Omar Azul closed the field with a younger, composed build that gave San Pedro one of the circuit’s cleanest and most controlled statements.
